content.tagline: Local governed canvas for VSI agents and Cabina evidence

vision.statement: Make Visual Studio Code Insiders the operator-visible workbench for governed agent control.
vision.problemStatement: Agent tools exist locally, but useful operation requires a shared map of surfaces, gates, validators, and evidence.
vision.proposedSolution: Seed Agile Agent Canvas with Cabina-native vision, PRD, epics, and explicit blocked/live lanes, then connect that evidence to the local dashboard and validators.

targetUsers.description: Approves lanes, chooses surfaces, and needs fast confidence without reading every repo file.

painPoints.painPoint: Too many installed agent extensions without a common map
Live boundaries can blur between local planning and provider writes

targetUsers.description: Executes safe repo and local changes with validators, rollback, and readback.

painPoints.painPoint: Unversioned local UI state is hard to review

goals.goal: Prefer existing capabilities before new ones

marketContext.overview: This is an internal workbench, not a commercial product. Its value is operational control over local and repo-scoped agent surfaces.
marketContext.targetMarket: Cabina Universal local operator and governed agent execution.

competitors.name: Unmapped extension inventory
competitors.description: Installed tools with no shared governance layer

competitors.name: Pure documentation
competitors.description: Governance files without an operator-facing workbench

keyFeatures.name: VSI agent surface map
keyFeatures.description: Inventory installed agent-like extensions and classify each as local, gated, or blocked.

keyFeatures.name: Governed canvas artifacts
keyFeatures.description: Keep vision, product brief, PRD, and epics as versioned local Agile Agent Canvas artifacts.

keyFeatures.name: Dashboard evidence bridge
keyFeatures.description: Expose governance controls and readiness states through the local agent bridge dashboard.

keyFeatures.name: Live gate packets
keyFeatures.description: Prepare exact target, owner, rollback, postcheck, validator, and stop condition before any live provider action.

successMetrics.description: Root canvas files no longer identify a demo project.
JSON parse, diff whitespace, dashboard tests, and governance validators pass.
No live provider writes are executed in this lane.
